answer.reason: The verses tell of Israel leaving its people in place and of its king and men being hired by Ammon for battle.

clauses.english: was not driven out by Israel, and its people dwelt among the Israelites
clauses.quote: the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites

clauses.english: had its king and a thousand men hired by Ammon for battle
clauses.quote: and of king Maacah a thousand men

doubts: 2SA 23:34 uses Maachathite only for the father of a warrior, so it was left out.
JOS 12:5 and JOS 13:11 give only the border, which the summary already covers.
